text: Binary flag from the OP's `argument` column only: 1 if the OP's own assertions include at least one absolute declarative statement, meaning a claim stated categorically and unconditionally with no hedge or qualifier (e.g. "always", "never", "all", "obviously", flat assertions of fact). 0 if the argument is assessable and has none. Hedging elsewhere does not matter, so an argument can have both. Ignore quoted text from others, quoted opponents' positions, and moderator/bot notices unless the OP adopts them. Use the current text including marked edits, but exclude OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if `argument` is missing or malformed.
